targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: THE LOAD-BEARING FINDING (Step 8 interactive gate, 2026-08-08: user confirmed 'flag to governance for review' over 'accept existing dismissal as-is'). Governance's 2026-04-22 reclassification of the 397/397c sibling runs to non_contributory reasoned: 'the hippo_quality_gap internal probe metric is sign-inverted... probe broken, not the mechanism.' 397d (2026-04-23) is a matched-endpoint, confound-corrected redesign built specifically to remove the destination-choice/path-choice confound the 2026-04-22 note identified (residue accumulates near goal-adjacent/hazard-proximate cells by env design; hippocampal trajectories correctly target those cells). With the confound removed, 397d reproduces the SAME value (-1.639377) as every prior formulation across a full month: 046@121655Z -1.6403(implied), 046@143303Z -1.640282, 046@162327Z -1.639694, 397 -1.640248, 397c x2 -1.638432/-1.640019, 397d(matched-endpoint) -1.639377. This cross-formulation-invariant recurrence across 6 independent runs and 2 distinct metric designs is a signal the 'probe broken' dismissal was incomplete -- the metric redesign specifically built to test that dismissal did not move the number at all. 397d itself has never been adjudicated (evidence_direction: weakens, no note, not superseded, not reclassified) -- a dropped thread: the finding that should have prompted re-examination of the 04-22 call was generated one day later and nobody closed the loop. RECOMMENDATION (per Step 8): flag to governance as a needs-review item revising the 2026-04-22 closure, do not treat it as final. This also interacts with ARC-007's independent 2026-07-25 demotion (active->provisional, EXQ-114's 99.2% figure found to be a denominator artefact) -- that demotion was leg-scoped to the behavioural translation and never folded in this internal-probe thread.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.note: not a substrate gap -- this is a request to re-examine a prior metric-validity call, not a build

learning_extracted: A metric redesign built specifically to test a 'probe is broken' dismissal, that reproduces the identical value with the confound removed, is itself evidence the dismissal needs re-examination -- do not let a corrected-metric replication be silently absorbed into the same disposition it was built to test.
